in_sanskrit.name: Barot
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain fort
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Barot एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Marathi word ‘baroda’, meaning ‘fort on a mountain’. This name is associated with strength, courage, and protection, evoking images of ancient hill forts and the warriors who defended them.
